name: _reduced-motion.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  draw-text/_reduced-motion.scss — reduced-motion overrides (both the
//  html.reduced-motion store flag via :host-context and the media query)
//  plus the shadow-scoped keyboard focus ring.
//  Imported by draw-text.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text__char,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a:hover .draw-text__word,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a:focus-visible .draw-text__word,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a:active .draw-text__word,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text__word {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
  filter: none;
  animation: none;
}

// Underline stays hover-only under reduced motion — no resting line.
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a:hover::after,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a:focus-visible::after,
:host-context(html.reduced-motion) .draw-text a:active::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
  opacity: 1;
  transition-delay: 0s;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .draw-text__char,
  .draw-text a:hover .draw-text__word,
  .draw-text a:focus-visible .draw-text__word,
  .draw-text a:active .draw-text__word,
  :host-context(button:hover) .draw-text__word,
  :host-context(button:focus-visible) .draw-text__word,
  :host-context(button:active) .draw-text__word {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    filter: none;
    animation: none;
  }

  .draw-text a:hover::after,
  .draw-text a:focus-visible::after,
  .draw-text a:active::after {
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 1;
    transition-delay: 0s;
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
